edge_definition.base_order: float32 m_bar, descending value, ascending patch ID tie break
edge_definition.orientation: strict base inversion i->j with m_bar_i < m_bar_j
edge_definition.q_m: ascending within-image score percentile from the exact float32 descending base order: (1369-1-rank_desc)/(1369-1), with ascending patch-ID ties

hodge_definition.gauge: mean potential zero independently in every edge-connected component
hodge_definition.isolated_node_convention: potential zero, target-only support degree zero, incident residual fraction zero
hodge_definition.objective: minimize sum over certified edges of ((p_i-p_j)-g_ij)^2

node_signal_definitions.S1: target-only certified-edge support degree: number of constraints for which the node is i in i->j
node_signal_definitions.S2: target-only support sum: sum of incoming target flows g_ij for which the node is i
node_signal_definitions.S3: target-only support RMS: sqrt(mean incoming g_ij^2), zero when target degree is zero
node_signal_definitions.S4: target-only support maximum: max incoming g_ij, zero when target degree is zero
node_signal_definitions.S6: deterministic within-image percentile rank of S5 over all 1369 nodes
node_signal_definitions.S7: incident residual-energy fraction: sum incident r_e^2 / (sum incident g_e^2 + 1e-12); zero for degree-zero nodes
